# Lyrenza Amsterdam Canal Quarter

## Permanent property facts

Lyrenza Amsterdam Canal Quarter is in Amsterdam, Netherlands, in the Europe region.
Facilities: Canal terrace; bicycle concierge; sauna; no pool. Pool or water-facility hours: No pool.
Parking: Limited valet parking; EUR 45 nightly. Transportation: Tram stop is two blocks away.

Accessible rooms include step-free routes and must be requested before arrival. Family
services and pet arrangements are confirmed with the reservation team.
